info.name: OpenRegister API: registers, schemas and configuration APIs (T21)
info.description: Covers the API routes of the registers, schemas, sources, configurations, applications, agents, endpoints, mappings, consumers, setup, federation and credential controllers: for each route the success path, an unknown id, invalid input where the method validates, and the access answer for a non-admin user (or anonymous caller) with a re-read proving nothing changed. The collection seeds its own data in `00 setup` (a non-admin user, a schema, a register, an object, and per-folder fixtures), stores every id in collection variables and removes it all in `99 teardown`; it depends on no other collection or seed data. Run with --env-var base_url, admin_user and admin_password.
